_comment: Plan 002 §7 P9 — language-neutral hello_ack vectors for the desktop credential handshake. Each vector is a hello_ack frame exactly as an agent writes it, plus the capability an app must derive from it. `unsupported` is the OLD-agent signal (the agent_capabilities key is absent, empty, or lists only other capabilities); `supported` requires the literal "credential.get" entry. The third app-side state, `unknown`, is deliberately NOT reachable from any frame here: it is the PRE-ACK state (no hello_ack seen yet on this connection), and conflating it with `unsupported` is the §7 P5 bug these vectors exist to prevent. Consumed by desktop/Tests/ShedKitTests/HostAgentCredentialFixtureTests.swift (the Swift client), crates/shed-app/src/host_agent.rs (the Rust client, through the real connection-state machine), and both agent suites (cmd/shed-host-agent/golden_test.go, crates/shed-host-agent/src/desktop_protocol.rs), which additionally assert that the ack THIS build emits is a `supported` one.
